appearance_facts.fact: Chart title reads 'Advertising Budget vs Revenue (High-Performing Regions)'.
Five blue circular scatter points are arranged in a strong upward diagonal from lower-left to upper-right.
Each point is individually labeled with a month name positioned just above it.
The May point is the highest and rightmost marker on the plot.
The January point is the lowest and leftmost marker on the plot.

printed_facts.fact: X-axis label is 'Advertising Budget ($)'; ticks are 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70.
Revenue increases monotonically with each monthly increase in advertising budget across all five labeled points.
